items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: in that band were such great players as Pee Wee Erwin

ctx.x: From there I got an offer to go with Joe Haymes, and I don't think enough has been written about Joe Haymes,

who was a marvelous arranger and pianist but then he stopped playing piano and just wrote for this band and we worked at a place called the McAlpine Hotel in New York for about 18 months and in that band were such great players as Pee Wee Erwin, is still on the scene today, playing very well.
